sources.title: AWS Bedrock User Guide - Knowledge Bases (retrieval and response generation with citations)
AWS Bedrock Converse API (messages, citations, tool use)
AWS Well-Architected - Agentic AI Lens (observability, cost, evaluation guidance)

findings.finding: Bedrock Knowledge Bases pairs retrieval with response generation and can attach source citations for the retrieved fragments; this makes it the fastest credible path to cited answers, while a custom RAG gives full control of index/n penalties and abstention thresholds.
findings.decision_impact: MVP-RAG-001 contract must allow both retrieval backends behind one interface.
findings.uncertainty: citation granularity (section vs chunk) and cost per query not pinned yet - verified during RAG-BACKEND-SPIKE.

findings.finding: Agentic AI guidance targets per-operation visibility: latency, tokens/cost per call and guardrails, and explicit evaluation of retrieval quality and generation fidelity for RAG systems.
findings.decision_impact: evaluation harness MVP-EVAL-001 and per-operation usage logging are Month-1/2 requirements, not afterthoughts.

findings.finding: The Bedrock Converse API abstracts model specifics and returns token usage; a thin injectable wrapper over it keeps tests offline with a fake client.
findings.decision_impact: MVP-LLM-001 wrapper must be dependency-injectable and offline-testable.

findings.finding: The owner prioritizes a small reliable product over incomplete features and accepts Bedrock-first retrieval for v1 with later comparison against custom RAG.
findings.decision_impact: RAG-BACKEND-SPIKE is time-boxed to one evening; default fallback is Bedrock-KBs-for-v1.

assumptions: Local development does NOT require AWS credentials (fake/mocked clients by default); AWS costs are only material from Month 2 and eval integration runs
Citations will reference document filename + section/chunk id; exact 'Section 4.2'-style semantics arrive from parsed document structure
Bedrock region availability for target models is assumed; actual region/model id chosen at integration time
contrary_evidence: Custom RAG proponents argue Bedrock-KB-first creates lock-in and hides retrieval internals; countered by requirement F4 (orintent/reliability first) and by keeping the retriever interface backend-agnostic
Over-tuned abstention can silence valid answers; countered by golden-case evaluation (MVP-EVAL-001) setting explicit thresholds and revisiting them

open_questions.question: Cost ceiling and region for Month-2 deployment (cost per query for KBs not pinned)?
Citation granularity achievable with parsed sections in MVP documents (PDF section detection quality)?
